jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The Opportunity: Senior Engineering Manager As an Engineering Manager at myTomorrows, you will lead Backend, Frontend, Full Stack and QA engineers building the platforms that help patients find their treatment options. Our Expanded Access Program (EAP) platform and Clinical Trials (CT) platform connect patients and healthcare professionals with treatments in development and give our BioPharma Partners the tools to run their programs and trials. You’ll shape how these platforms grow, building a high-performing team that ships well-designed, scalable, secure and compliant software, and delivers it on time. You won’t do it alone. jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader
jobs.description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn. Summary of Position: The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team. This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients world

jobs.title: 1191 - Scheduler
jobs.description: We Make Remote Work Remarkable • TopTalent from LatAm Hello! We are GoFasti , a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe. We need an English-fluent Scheduler , based in Latin America, available to work remotely. We are looking for someone with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills, who embraces changes while maintaining strong attention to detail. An interested and proactive person, who's constantly learning and improving their skills. Are you the one we are looking for? Responsibilities: Create, assign, and manage all client visits in WellSky, including Start of Care (SOC), Recertification, Resumption of Care (ROC), Follow-Up, and Routine visits. Build and maintain accurate visit schedules for skilled nursing (RN/LPN), therapy (PT, OT, SLP), and aide staff. Enter and update visit authorizations based on payer source, including Medicare, Medicaid, private pay, and managed care plans. Process physician orders tied to visit frequency and duration within WellSky. Monitor the scheduling dashboard daily for unscheduled, missed, or conflicting visits. Coordinate with the clinical team to ensure visit frequency aligns with the Plan of Care (485). Match field clinicians and aides to clients based on availability, geographic location, skill set, and payer requirements. Maintain staff availability calendars, including PTO, call-outs, and schedule changes. Communicate schedule changes to clinicians, aides, and supervisors in a prompt and professional manner. Identify and fill coverage gaps to prevent missed visits and care disruptions. Maintain accurate employee profiles in WellSky, including credentials and authorized service types. Verify and track visit authorizations for all payers prior to scheduling any visit. Alert the billing and intake teams of authorization changes, expirations, or denials in a timely manner. jobs.title: Clinical Trial Manager
jobs.location: Hungary,  Poland,  Romania,  Serbia,  Slovakia,  Spain,  UK
jobs.description: Precision for Medicine is looking for an experienced Clinical Trial Manager to join our growing team. Candidates can work remotely in Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, UK or Spain. Precision for Medicine is a precision medicine CRO. Precision’s uniquely integrated offering enables the science of precision medicine by combining novel clinical trial designs, industry-leading operational and medical experts, advanced biomarker and data analytics solutions, and an unequivocal real passion for rare diseases and oncology, in addition to working across other therapeutic areas. You will be the hub of central intelligence for the studies you will be managing and will lead CRAs and oversee all clinical aspects of your study across multiple countries, ensuring timeline adherence and scope, whilst ensuring quality delivery. We encourage high-energy, dedicated professionals who enjoy a challenge, thrive in the details and flourish in dynamic environments to explore this opportunity. We are addressing the challenges facing the research and development of novel compounds in Oncology and are dedicated to positively impacting the health and lives of patients around the world. If you take a consultative approach to trial management, proving to be a valuable partner in the trial operational delivery process, don't miss exploring working with us. About You: You love having responsibility and a say in how clinical trials are run You plan ahead, but have alternative options and a flexible approach You are client focused You are well organised and able to manage timelines and shifting priorities, without sacrificing quality.
